stem: Which hundredths model is shaded to represent the equation 0.7 \times 0.7 = 0.49 ?
visual_elements: One hundredths model fully shaded representing one whole
Option A: hundredths model with top 7 columns shaded and bottom 5 rows shaded with some overlap
Option B: hundredths model with top 7 columns shaded and bottom 7 rows shaded fully overlapping
Option C: hundredths model with top 7 columns shaded and a darker 7x7 overlap near top-left
Option D: hundredths model with left 3 columns shaded fully and inside 7 columns shaded lighter
